content: Close the two worthwhile small items from the agent/ re-assessment: dual-source status consistency (current-progress freshness plus latest-session versus plan status drift) and a self-test suite for the record validator itself. The remaining three small items (experience revalidation triggers, parallel-writer protocol, distillation cutoff redesign) stay deliberately deferred until scale demands them.

Current-progress freshness is an error-grade rule: progress/current.md must reference the newest recorded checkpoint; unknown or stale references fail validation because both mean forgotten bookkeeping with an unambiguous fix.

Status drift between the latest complete session and plan frontmatter is warning-grade: either side may be legitimately ahead, so only the newest complete session is compared (older sessions legitimately reflect their own time) and mismatches warn rather than fail.
Write tools/test-check-agent-records.py: synthetic golden agent tree in a temporary directory, fifteen mutation cases, validator loaded by path, asserting exit codes and warning presence.

15/15 cases pass after fixing one fixture bug (a mutation key was a table row instead of a file path, making the missing-index-row case a silent no-op). Wired as CTest metaflux.architecture.agent-records-selftest with the architecture label.

Repository validation ok (4 sessions, 44 events, 60 Markdown) with no false positives from the new rules; dev preset 16/16 including both architecture tests. The session scaffolder's fixed index-row insertion was verified to place this session's row at the end of the table, not the end of the file.
